data.title: Cloudflare Announces Open-Source Cloudflare OS As AI "Operating System"
data.description: Cloudflare today announced the open-sourcing of Cloudflare OS as an 'open platform for agents, apps, and work.' Cloudflare OS is an AI 'operating system' but not in the traditional OS sense.
